allowInsecureImages.description: Bitnami common library escape hatch, required for the bitnamilegacy postgresql image redirect

adaptSecurityContext.description: Drop fixed runAsUser/runAsGroup/fsGroup for OpenShift SCC compatibility: auto (detect), force, or disabled

apis.description: How OpenShift-only objects detect their API: auto (ask the API server) or force (render without detection, for GitOps or offline helm template)

name.description: Name of the image pull Secret

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for private registries

jwtSecret.description: JWT signing secret: empty (zero-config bootstrap generates one on first start) or at least 32 characters

adminEmail.description: Admin account email: empty means the app's own default (admin@libredb.org), otherwise a valid address

userEmail.description: User account email: empty means the app's own default (user@libredb.org), otherwise a valid address

adminTotpSecret.description: Admin TOTP secret: empty (no second factor) or base32 (RFC 4648: A-Z and 2-7; spaces, hyphens and trailing = are stripped), at least 26 characters so the decoded secret carries the 128 bits RFC 4226 requires

userTotpSecret.description: User TOTP secret: empty (no second factor) or base32 (RFC 4648: A-Z and 2-7; spaces, hyphens and trailing = are stripped), at least 26 characters so the decoded secret carries the 128 bits RFC 4226 requires

oidcExistingSecret.description: A Secret holding only the OIDC client id and secret (keys from existingSecretKeys.oidcClientId and oidcClientSecret): OIDC_CLIENT_ID and OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET come from it and nothing else does. Needs authProvider=oidc; refuses existingSecret, oidcClientId and oidcClientSecret beside it

governancePostgresUrl.description: The governance source URL for Studio's own role (GOVERNANCE_POSTGRES_URL): required when governance.enabled=true unless existingSecret carries it

governancePrivateKeys.description: The keyring document that opens sealed credentials, mounted read-only at /etc/libredb/governance/keyring.json and never an environment variable: required when governance.enabled=true unless existingSecret carries it

basePath.description: Build-time BASE_PATH of the custom image; prefixes default probes, not a runtime app setting

bindAddress.description: Address the container listens on, written to HOSTNAME. Empty (the default) lets the image resolve it and prefer a verified dual-stack "::"; set "::" to force that, or an IPv4 literal such as "0.0.0.0" to pin the container to IPv4.

authBootstrap.description: AUTH_BOOTSTRAP for the app: "" (chart default: omit the variable, the app's zero-config first run applies), "on" (explicit zero-config), or "off" (strict: secrets.jwtSecret and secrets.adminPassword are required). The app's synonyms "true"/"1" (on) and "false"/"0" (off) are accepted for upgrade compatibility, case-insensitive.

authCookieSecure.description: AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE for the app: null (default) writes nothing and the app decides (Secure in production, except a loopback host reached over plain http), false drops the Secure flag - the answer for a browser reaching a non-loopback host over plain http, where the cookie is rejected and login silently loops - and true forces it on

passkeyOrigin.description: PASSKEY_ORIGIN for the app: the public origin people open Studio at (scheme, host and optional port, no path), such as https://studio.example.com. Empty (default) writes nothing and passkeys stay off. Needs storageProvider sqlite or postgres, local auth, and an application image that includes passkey sign-in (#785); appVersion 0.17.0 does not read it. The app validates the value

llmModelEffort.description: LLM_MODEL_EFFORT, the reasoning effort for llmProvider openai only. Empty (default) writes nothing and the model keeps its own default. Which values a model takes is the model's own (GPT-6.1 Sol has no none), and the app refuses the variable with any other provider. Needs an application image after 1.0.0; 1.0.0 does not read it

oidcRolePrefix.description: OIDC_ROLE_PREFIX: case-sensitive prefix filter for custom seed roles from the OIDC role claim

oidcUserRoles.description: OIDC_USER_ROLES (comma-separated): empty writes nothing; required when governance.enabled=true

oidcPrompt.description: OIDC_PROMPT: empty writes nothing and the app sends login; omit sends no prompt, so a provider session signs in silently

oidcAutoRedirect.description: OIDC_AUTO_REDIRECT: false (default) writes nothing, true sends a signed-out visitor of /login straight to the identity provider

oidcLogoutHint.description: OIDC_LOGOUT_HINT: false (default) writes nothing, true sends id_token_hint with the end-session request

sessionTtlSeconds.description: AUTH_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS: null (default) writes nothing and the app keeps 86400, otherwise whole seconds from 300 to 86400

allowCustomConnections.description: ALLOW_CUSTOM_CONNECTIONS: null (default) writes nothing and the app keeps custom connections on, false switches them off so only seed connections open, true writes true; governance refuses true

seedLiteralValues.description: SEED_LITERAL_VALUES: false (default) writes nothing, true reads every seed value as written and resolves no ${ENV} or ${vault:...} reference

storagePostgresSchema.description: STORAGE_POSTGRES_SCHEMA: empty writes nothing, otherwise a lowercase identifier of up to 63 characters; required when governance.enabled=true

enabled.description: Run Studio under governance: writes GOVERNANCE_SOURCE=postgres, mounts the keyring and moves the readiness probe to /api/ready

postgresSchema.description: GOVERNANCE_POSTGRES_SCHEMA: the schema the governance source lives in

instanceId.description: GOVERNANCE_INSTANCE_ID: empty uses the chart's fullname with one replica and each pod's name with more; a set value fails the render with more than one replica

refreshMs.description: GOVERNANCE_REFRESH_MS: null (default) writes nothing and the app keeps 30000

maxStalenessMs.description: GOVERNANCE_MAX_STALENESS_MS: null (default) writes nothing and the app keeps 120000; at least refreshMs

allowedEngines.description: GOVERNANCE_ALLOWED_ENGINES (comma-separated engine type ids): empty (default) writes nothing and the app keeps its default list

enabled.description: Explicit off-switch for the agent runtime: null (default) writes nothing and lets the app derive availability from the AI configuration plus a writable ledger, false writes LIBREDB_AGENT_ENABLED=false, true declines the off-switch without conjuring a model

threadContext.description: Whether a run may be told about the conversation it belongs to: null (default) writes nothing and the app keeps its own default, which is on; false writes LIBREDB_AGENT_THREAD_CONTEXT=false, so every run opens on its own and the rail says so

enabled.description: Serve /api/mcp: false (default) writes no LIBREDB_MCP_* variable; true writes all four as strings and requires url and tokenLabel

url.description: The address MCP clients use and every token is bound to: an absolute http(s) URL ending in /api/mcp, with config.basePath when one is set

tokenLabel.description: Any non-empty value; the token signing key is derived under it, so changing it revokes every MCP token at once

tokenTtlDays.description: Days a minted MCP token stays valid

emptyDirSizeLimit.description: Size limit for the /app/data emptyDir used when persistence is disabled: empty (unlimited) or a quantity such as 512Mi

fixPermissions.description: Chown the mounted /app/data volume to runAsUser:fsGroup in a root init container (statically provisioned volumes the kubelet does not fsGroup, e.g. hostPath)

ipFamilyPolicy.description: Service address families: SingleStack, PreferDualStack or RequireDualStack; empty renders no field and leaves the cluster default

ipFamilies.description: Explicit address-family order, e.g. [IPv4, IPv6]; entry 0 is the immutable primary family. Two entries require ipFamilyPolicy PreferDualStack or RequireDualStack

route.description: Route configuration (gateway API). Keys are route names; top-level `labels` and `annotations` apply to all routes.

apiVersion.description: Kubernetes API version for the route

kind.description: Kubernetes resource kind for the route. Only HTTPRoute is supported: the template renders an HTTPRoute-shaped body (path matches), which other route kinds reject

parentRefs.description: parentRefs for the route (see Gateway API)

httpsRedirect.description: If true, add an HTTPS redirect filter

labels.description: Labels to add to all route resources

annotations.description: Annotations to add to all route resources

openshiftRoute.description: OpenShift Route (route.openshift.io/v1) to the Service's http port

enabled.description: Render the Route; needs route.openshift.io/v1 or global.compatibility.openshift.apis=force

host.description: Route host; empty lets the router generate one

termination.description: TLS termination; only edge, since the image has no TLS listener

insecureEdgeTerminationPolicy.description: What the router does with plain HTTP

timeout.description: haproxy.router.openshift.io/timeout, e.g. 120s; empty omits the annotation

enabled.description: Mount the cluster's injected trusted CA bundle and set NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS; needs config.openshift.io/v1 or global.compatibility.openshift.apis=force

partOf.description: app.kubernetes.io/part-of label on every Deployment and pod template; empty renders none

runtime.description: app.openshift.io/runtime label (Topology icon) on every Deployment and pod template; empty renders none

enabled.description: Records that cookie affinity is configured at the ingress: under governance.enabled, more than one replica or autoscaling renders only with this set. Renders nothing itself

minAvailable.description: Minimum available pods (mutually exclusive with maxUnavailable; unset with null when using maxUnavailable)

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum unavailable pods (mutually exclusive with minAvailable)

annotations.description: ServiceAccount annotations (e.g., for IRSA or Workload Identity)

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount an API token into the pod, set on the pod spec and on the created ServiceAccount; Studio reads it only for Vault Kubernetes auth (VAULT_ROLE)

extraVolumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts for the app container (Kubernetes VolumeMount objects)

extraObjects.description: Additional Kubernetes manifests deployed with the release, each rendered through tpl (an object, or a string taken as a template)

repository.description: PostgreSQL image repository (bitnamilegacy after the Bitnami catalog freeze)
volumePermissions helper image repository (bitnamilegacy after the Bitnami catalog freeze)
postgres-exporter image repository (bitnamilegacy after the Bitnami catalog freeze)

existingSecret.description: Mount the seed file from this existing Secret instead of a ConfigMap; set one source only

navLink.description: A ui.cattle.io/v1 NavLink to Studio, rendered only when the cluster serves that API

enabled.description: Render the NavLink; needs ingress.enabled with a host

group.description: The navigation group the link appears under

target.description: The browser target the link opens in

iconSrc.description: The link's icon, as an https URL or a data:image URI; empty uses the LibreDB logo inline

enabled.description: Switch the access review on; needs authProvider=oidc and config.sessionTtlSeconds of at most 900

cacheSeconds.description: KUBERNETES_ACCESS_REVIEW_CACHE_SECONDS: null (default) writes nothing and the app keeps 30, otherwise whole seconds from 0 to 60

signIn.description: KUBERNETES_ACCESS_REVIEW_SIGN_IN, as kubectl auth can-i takes it: <verb> <resource>[.<group>][/<name>] [-n <namespace>]. Empty (default) writes nothing and the app keeps list navlinks.ui.cattle.io

tokenExpirationSeconds.description: Lifetime of the projected token the reviews authenticate with

kubernetes.description: Kubernetes discovery: the exporter Deployment, its RBAC, the export Secret and Studio's mount; see docs/SEED_CONNECTIONS.md

enabled.description: Run the exporter and read its export

kinds.description: KUBERNETES_DISCOVERY_KINDS: empty (default) writes nothing and the exporter reads every supported kind

maxAgeMs.description: SEED_KUBERNETES_DISCOVERY_MAX_AGE_MS: null (default) writes nothing and the app keeps 180000
